title: Perimeter and Area of Plane Shapes
seo_title: Perimeter and Area – JSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the perimeter and area of rectangles, squares, triangles, parallelograms and composite shapes. (summary of the NERDC JSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 1 maths worksheets on perimeter and area: rectangles, triangles, parallelograms and composite shapes, with missing lengths. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Perimeter is the total length of the boundary. Area is the space inside, in square units.
  • Rectangle: l × b. Triangle: ½ × b × h. Parallelogram: b × h. Trapezium: ½(a + b)h.
  • Circle: circumference = 2πr, area = πr² (use π = 22/7 or 3.14).

Examples

Example

Trapezium with parallel sides 8 cm and 12 cm, height 5 cm

½ × 20 × 5

Answer: 50 cm²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Using a slant side as the heightThe height is perpendicular to the base.
Mixing unitsChange to one unit first.
Giving area in cmArea is in cm².
